components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on a page or dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f7d74, #14998a); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 20px; font: 600 15px Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0b6a62, #0f8679); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f7d74; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #fff; color: #0f7d74; border: 1px solid #dae8e4; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 20px; font: 600 15px Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #e3f6f1; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f7d74; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 600 13px Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #14303a; } .ds-field input { border: 1px solid #dae8e4; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 15px Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; background: #fff; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0f7d74; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15, 125, 116, .16); }

components.name: Badges
components.html: Home visit Clinic Online
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 12px Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; background: #e8f4e2; color: #2f6b2a; } .ds-pill.home { background: #fdece8; color: #a63a26; } .ds-pill.online { background: #e3f6f1; color: #0b4f5c; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dae8e4; border-radius: 14px; padding: 22px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(11,79,92,.05), 0 6px 18px rgba(11,79,92,.05); font: 400 15px Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #14303a; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; color: #0b4f5c; font-size: 15px; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: #0b4f5c; }

components.name: Side menu item
components.description: Item in the dark river menu; active state tinted.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: linear-gradient(165deg, #083e49, #0b4f5c 35%, #0f7d74 85%); padding: 12px; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav a { color: #d6e4f2; text-decoration: none; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font: 500 15px Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); } .ds-nav a.on { background: rgba(159,220,207,.2); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9fdccf; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The portal should feel like a tidy, well-lit clinic: white work surfaces on a pale water-green ground, deep river teal for the things you act on, and the Nile running through it as soft teal gradients and the lotus watermark. Colour is used richly but with meaning: teal for action and data, coral for home visits and attention, leaf green for done, slate for the fourth category. Arabic and English are equals.
keyCharacteristics: White cards (14px corners, soft two-layer shadow) on a pale water-green page.
Pill-shaped buttons and badges; deep teal gradient for primary actions.
Dark river-teal side menu with the lotus watermark.
Colour-coded categories using the full brand palette.
Drawn stroke icons (1em, follow text colour); no emoji as icons.

rules.name: The Red Means Trouble Rule
rules.body: Danger red appears only for a real problem (an error, a delete, a patient nobody took). Never as decoration.

rules.name: The Colour Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Every colour on a screen names a category or a state. Use the full palette to tell kinds apart, and keep the same colour for the same kind everywhere (home visit coral, clinic green, online teal).

rules.name: The Readable Badge Rule
rules.body: Text on a tinted badge uses the palette's ink shade (brand-ink, coral-ink, leaf-ink), never the mid tone.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing a user needs to read is smaller than 12px (11px only for a two-letter initials tag).

dos: Do use drawn stroke icons from the portal's icon() set (1em, current colour).
Do give every category its own palette colour and reuse it everywhere.
Do keep badge text in the ink shades so it passes 4.5:1.
Do check every screen in Arabic (right-to-left) and English, at 375px and on a laptop.
donts: Don't put a coloured stripe down one side of a card or chip.
Don't use red for anything but a real problem.
Don't go below 12px for readable text.
